content.value_statement: Short-form videos lose viewers when the first seconds are vague or slow. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code generate, critique, and refine hooks for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
actual_capabilities: Generates six to ten hook options across multiple named archetypes.
Drafts verbal lines, first-frame visuals, and on-screen text for each hook.
Critiques draft hooks against checklist items and common anti-patterns.
Adapts hook pacing and text style for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
Helps select archetypes for product, education, opinion, and paid ad videos.
Provides worksheet-based three-layer hook planning before shooting.
limitations: Does not guarantee virality or platform distribution.
Does not access live trend data or current platform analytics.
Does not replace full script strategy beyond the opening hook.
Requires accurate audience, platform, and offer details for best results.

use_cases.title: Generate Hook Batches
use_cases.description: Create several hook angles before filming, with spoken lines, first-frame ideas, and on-screen text.

use_cases.title: Repair Weak Openers
use_cases.description: Diagnose why an existing opening loses attention and rewrite it into stronger variants.

use_cases.title: Adapt Paid Social Hooks
use_cases.description: Shape product or offer hooks for cold audiences while keeping the promise specific and defensible.

prompt_templates.title: Generate A Hook Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use viral-hooks to create eight hooks for this video idea: [idea]. Audience: [audience]. Platform: [TikTok, Reels, or Shorts]. Include verbal line, first frame, on-screen text, and archetype.

prompt_templates.title: Improve A Weak Opener
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for critique and rewrites.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use viral-hooks to critique this draft opener: [draft]. Identify the main anti-pattern, explain the attention drop, and rewrite three stronger versions for [platform].

prompt_templates.title: Choose The Best Archetype
prompt_templates.prompt: Use viral-hooks to match this video idea to three hook archetypes: [idea]. Explain the tradeoff for each archetype and write one example hook for each.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Platform Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use viral-hooks to adapt this hook for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts: [hook]. Keep the core promise, adjust pacing and text placement, and recommend two A/B test variants.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for hooks for a reusable cold-brew maker video.
output: Contrarian: Your expensive coffee setup is why it tastes worse. First frame: two cups beside price tags. Text: Price is not flavor.
Investigator: I tested six cold-brew makers under $50. First frame: lineup of makers. Text: Six tested, one kept.
Cost confession: I spent $413 on coffee gear so you can skip it. First frame: receipts beside the product. Text: $413 to $39.

output_examples.input: A manager asks why an opener starts with a brand introduction.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: brand-first opener. The first second centers the seller instead of the viewer payoff. Rewrite: Your serum is not failing. Your order is.

output_examples.input: A marketer wants one hook adapted for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
output: TikTok: use the fastest verbal payoff and native text in the upper third.
Reels: lead with a stronger paused first frame and larger text.
Shorts: echo the title in the first spoken line and avoid bottom text placement.

best_practices: Provide the video idea, target viewer, platform, goal, and constraints.
Ask for multiple archetypes, then film two or three variants.
Compare the hook promise with the video payoff before publishing.
anti_patterns: Asking for one generic hook with no audience or platform context.
Using vague teases, welcome intros, or brand-first openers.
Treating the generated hook as guaranteed performance advice.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee a viral video?
faq.answer: No. It improves hook quality through proven patterns, but platform performance still depends on audience, content, timing, and execution.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports hook planning for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

faq.question: Can it critique an existing hook?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the draft opener and platform, and it will identify weaknesses and rewrite stronger variants.

faq.question: Does it write full video scripts?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on the opening hook and may suggest handing off to a script-focused workflow.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the topic, audience, platform, goal, constraints, and any existing draft.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
